title: Expand safety gate for generic Agent execution

implementation.summary: Expanded SafetyGateConfig so the generic Agent execution gate requires both cargo test -p agentd safety:: and cargo test -p agentd agent_core::adversarial.

runtime_gate_manifest.command: cargo test -p agentd safety:: && cargo test -p agentd agent_core::adversarial

verification.ci_workflow: .github/workflows/safety.yml already runs cargo test -p agentd agent_core::adversarial
verification.release_workflow: .github/workflows/release.yml and scripts/build-release.ps1 already run cargo test -p agentd agent_core::adversarial

notes: TASK-ACR-010 added the runtime adversarial test implementation; TASK-SEF-008 promotes that subset into the safety gate manifest.
Denied and paused runtime paths are covered by the AgentCore adversarial tests and continue to assert absence of EffectPrepared for protected or injected steps.
